name: Sympathetic Ring
description: Let the user's soul ring in sympathy with an ally's until the ally's technique answers with fuller strength.

name: Harmonic Read
description: Read the overtones of an ally's soul to learn the depth of their reserve and the weak places in it.

name: Chiming Guard
description: Ring the soul against a hostile tone so the sound breaks the shape of the attack.

name: Counter Melody
description: Answer an ally's soul strike with a second line that follows the first and doubles its effect.

name: Companion Swell
description: Swell the note of the user beneath an ally's strongest technique so it carries farther and cuts cleaner.

name: Calm Ring
description: Ring the soul of an ally in a calm slow beat to shake off dread laid on them by a hostile tone.

name: Resonant Embrace
description: Wrap an ally in a steady field of matched soul tone that cleans their technique of waver and disruption.

name: Overtone Mending
description: Lay rich overtones through an ally's torn soul until the tears close and the full tone returns.

name: Tone Reading
description: Spread a faint field of tone and learn the rung and mood of every soul it touches.

name: Tone Murmur
description: Hum a field of tone over a squad of allies so each soul technique among them sounds a little clearer.

name: Fielded Ward
description: Fold the field close to the user as a ward that thins the hostile soul force passing through it.

name: Tone Mending
description: Let the field settle over a strained ally and fill the gaps in their soul tone from its own pool.

name: Growing Swell
description: Let the field grow louder with each beat so allied souls inside it gain strength as the beat climbs.

name: Tone Purge
description: Shake the field to loosen hostile taint clinging to those inside it and cast it out as noise.

name: Discord Wave
description: Hurl a wave of jarring tone through a group of foes so their joined soul work comes apart.

name: Rousing Peal
description: Peal a great bell of soul tone over an ally whose soul was stunned loose and ring it home within the short window.

name: Tone Crest
description: Raise the field to a great crest in which every ally's soul work runs at its clearest for a long moment.

name: Twin Murmur
description: Hum two notes in pair and give one to an ally so that both souls rise together.

name: Partner Reading
description: Match the soul of the user to one partner and read their state through the paired tone.

name: Counterpart Aegis
description: Set two tones side by side as a paired guard so a hostile soul blow splits between them.

name: Paired Mending
description: Sing a second voice under a hurt partner's soul tone until the frayed line is whole again.

name: Hawk Cry
description: Loose a hawk's piercing cry through the soul to startle an opponent's mind.

name: Dual Strain
description: Run the note of the user and a partner's on two parallel tracks so each fills the other's quiet places.

name: Paired Rinse
description: Wash a dread from a partner's soul with the second voice of a pair.

name: Azure Answer
description: Answer a partner's soul strike with a clear high note so that both land as one stroke.

name: Twin Ascent
description: Lift two souls together up a rising pair of tones so both gain strength and depth through the climb.

name: Pair Revival
description: Call a stunned partner's soul back within the short window by sounding their own paired note until they answer.

name: Clear Note
description: Send one clear high note into an ally so that doubt falls away from their soul technique.

name: Hawk Hearing
description: Listen like a hawk over a wide space for any soul that wavers or hides.

name: Feather Ward
description: Spread a light ward of tone like a feather that slows a hostile soul blow.

name: Glad Note
description: Sound a glad note over a downcast ally to lift the grief that drags at their soul.

name: High Lift
description: Sound a high bright line above an ally's technique so that it climbs and carries farther.

name: Cry Release
description: Cry a sharp note that breaks a lock of hostile tone from an ally and sets them free.

name: Falling Peal
description: Drop a bright falling peal over a clump of foes that shakes their souls and breaks their formation.

name: Azure Concord
description: Hold a vast bright concord over the allied company so every soul in it works with greater clarity.

name: Oath Note
description: Sing a sworn note to an ally so their soul holds firm to the work they have promised.

name: Wind Hearing
description: Let the wind carry a soft tone out and bring back the signature of every soul it passes.

name: Sworn Ward
description: Sing a sworn ward round the user that a hostile soul tone must break before it can bite.

name: Breath Mend
description: Breathe an oath song across an ally's soul and let it knit the fraying as the wind smooths cloth.

name: Wind Chorus
description: Join allies in a wind-borne chorus so their soul work travels together on one long breath.

name: Oath Release
description: Sing the oath of release over an ally and loosen the hostile bonds of tone on their soul.

name: Gale Refrain
description: Sing a refrain on the gale so each ally's soul strike follows the last in unbroken line.

name: Unbroken Oath
description: Sing an unbroken oath through the company until each soul cannot be shaken from its task.

name: Wind Revival
description: Call the stunned soul of a fallen ally back on a long sworn wind within the short window before it scatters.

name: Bearing Tone
description: Take a bearing on every nearby soul by the tone it returns.

name: Held Bearing
description: Hold a bearing note beside an ally so their soul keeps its course through a storm of noise.

name: Settling Note
description: Sound a settling note that steadies a shaken ally's soul and quiets the tremor in it.

name: Wind Screen
description: Spread a screen of airy tone that turns aside a hostile soul stroke like a gust.

name: Sworn Strike
description: Strike an opponent's soul with a hard sworn note that rings in their mind.

name: Bearing Lift
description: Lift an ally's soul onto a true bearing so their technique finds its mark more cleanly.

name: Clear Heading
description: Restore an ally's true heading in the soul after a hostile tone has turned them about.

name: False Bearing
description: Send a false bearing tone to foes so their joined soul work drifts off its common course.

name: Long Bearing
description: Hold a long bearing note over the company so that every soul keeps to its true course under pressure.

name: Wide Bearing
description: Ring a great bearing tone that returns the soul position of every cultivator within a wide reach.
